config.description: Single quick state owner for raw power/presets/directions. A token-guarded restart script debounces power; native timer bounds the secret chord. No waits here. Cursor reset and decoding are serialized. Logical commands launch asynchronously so actuator latency cannot drop input. Every raw power event invalidates the preset cursor. Cursor -1 means no subsequent preset has been observed; first 0/4 is right/left. Unavailable cursor remains unknown.

sequence.alias: Resynchronize the hardware preset cursor on raw power before any arrow can arrive

if.value_template: {{ payload is not mapping or payload.get('action') not in ['color_temperature_move','brightness_move_to_level'] }}
{{ preset is not number or preset is boolean or preset not in presets }}

variables.delta: {{ (1 if index==0 else 4 if index==4 else -1) if previous==-1 else (index-previous|int)%5 if previous in [0,1,2,3,4] else -1 }}

variables.command: {{ 'right' if delta==1 else 'left' if delta==4 else 'cancel' }}
